response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_model_confidence FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS value FROM compliancecase), qualifying AS (SELECT s.status, s.avg_model_confidence, b.value AS baseline_value FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE s.avg_model_confidence > b.value), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_model_confidence) AS value FROM qualifying) SELECT q.status, q.avg_model_confidence, q.avg_model_confidence - q.baseline_value AS difference_from_baseline, q.avg_model_confidence / m.value AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying AS q CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean AS m WHERE q.baseline_value IS NOT NULL AND m.value IS NOT NULL
